name: Mountain run hill repeats 8x2
description: Eight short, very steep, very fast climbs. 6.0 km/h at 11 % is a hard power-hike; running form is not possible on this machine.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy and smooth. Nose breathing, shoulders loose.

steps.name: Steep hill
steps.notes: RPE 8. Short quick steps, drive the arms.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Let the breathing settle; sip water.
